name: glow-select
title: Glow Select
description: The select the field family was missing. The trigger wears GlowInput's own class strings and the menu wears StickerPopover's own surface — both imported, so neither can drift from the component it came from. Radix Select underneath for typeahead, roving highlight, collision-aware positioning and a hidden native select that still submits. Sizes sm and default, frame={false} for a select that is a row action.
